197	async def build_hot_context_solo(
198	    pool: Any,
199	    user: User,
200	    triggering_message_ids: list[UUID],
201	    trigger_metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
202	    *,
203	    primary_topic_id: UUID,
204	    bot_id: str,
205	    allow_cross_topic_peek: bool = False,
206	) -> HotContextSolo:
207	    """Build hot context for a solo bot turn.
208	
209	    Raises:
210	        ValueError: if primary_topic_id is None (no defensive fallback, lesson #6).
211	    """
212	    if primary_topic_id is None:
213	        raise ValueError("build_hot_context_solo: primary_topic_id must not be None")
214	
215	    topic_status = await _fetch_topic_status_solo(
216	        pool, topic_id=primary_topic_id, user_id=user.id
217	    )
218	    current_user = await _user_profile_solo(pool, user)
219	    partner_user: dict[str, Any] = {}
220	    now_utc = datetime.now(UTC)
221	    user_timezone = timezone_or_utc(current_user.get("timezone") or user.timezone).key
222	
223	    # Conversation load for this user only
224	    conversation_load_row = await pool.fetchrow(
225	        """\
226	        WITH bounds AS (
227	            SELECT
228	                date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE $2) AT TIME ZONE $2 AS period_start,
229	                (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE $2) + interval '1 day') AT TIME ZONE $2 AS period_end
230	        )
231	        SELECT
232	            bounds.period_start,
233	            bounds.period_end,
234	            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.direction = 'inbound') AS inbound_count,
235	            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.direction = 'outbound') AS outbound_count,
236	            COUNT(m.id) AS total_count
237	        FROM bounds
238	        LEFT JOIN messages m
239	            ON m.deleted_at IS NULL
240	           AND (m.sender_id = $1 OR m.recipient_id = $1)
241	           AND m.sent_at >= bounds.period_start
242	           AND m.sent_at < bounds.period_end
243	        GROUP BY bounds.period_start, bounds.period_end
244	        """,
245	        user.id,
246	        user_timezone,
247	    )
248	    conversation_load = {
249	        "period": "today",
250	        "timezone": user_timezone,
251	        "period_start": _iso(conversation_load_row["period_start"]) if conversation_load_row else None,
252	        "period_end": _iso(conversation_load_row["period_end"]) if conversation_load_row else None,
253	        "inbound_count": int(conversation_load_row["inbound_count"] or 0) if conversation_load_row else 0,
254	        "outbound_count": int(conversation_load_row["outbound_count"] or 0) if conversation_load_row else 0,
255	        "total_count": int(conversation_load_row["total_count"] or 0) if conversation_load_row else 0,
256	    }
257	
258	    # OOB: only for the user (no partner)
259	    active_oob = [
260	        {
261	            "id": row["id"],
262	            "owner_id": row["owner_id"],
263	            "severity": row["severity"],
264	            "shareable_context": row["shareable_context"],
265	            "protected_summary": row["shareable_context"] or "[protected]",
266	            "review_at": _iso(row["review_at"]),
267	            "review_at_time": _time_context(row["review_at"], user_timezone, now_utc),
268	        }
269	        for row in await pool.fetch(
270	            f"""\
271	            SELECT x.id, x.owner_id, x.shareable_context, x.severity, x.review_at
272	            FROM out_of_bounds x
273	            {join_artifact_topics('x', '$2')}
274	            WHERE x.status = 'active' AND x.owner_id = $1
275	            ORDER BY CASE x.severity WHEN 'hard' THEN 1 WHEN 'firm' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, x.created_at DESC
276	            """,
277	            user.id,
278	            primary_topic_id,
279	        )
280	    ]
281	
282	    # Memories: only about the user, scoped to primary topic
283	    memories = [
284	        {
285	            "id": row["id"],
286	            "about_user_id": row["about_user_id"],
287	            "content": row["content"],
288	            "related_theme_ids": _clean_list(row["related_theme_ids"]),
289	            "last_referenced_at": _iso(row["last_referenced_at"]),
290	            "created_at": _iso(row["created_at"]),
291	            "last_referenced_at_time": _time_context(row["last_referenced_at"], user_timezone, now_utc),
292	            "created_at_time": _time_context(row["created_at"], user_timezone, now_utc),
293	        }
294	        for row in await pool.fetch(
295	            f"""\
296	            SELECT m.id, m.about_user_id, m.content, COALESCE(m.related_theme_ids, '{{}}'::uuid[]) AS related_theme_ids,
297	                   m.last_referenced_at, m.created_at
298	            FROM memories m
299	            {join_artifact_topics('m', '$2')}
300	            WHERE m.status = 'active' AND m.about_user_id = $1
301	            ORDER BY COALESCE(m.last_referenced_at, m.created_at) DESC
302	            LIMIT 80
303	            """,
304	            user.id,
305	            primary_topic_id,
306	        )
307	    ]
308	
309	    # Active themes: scoped to primary topic
310	    active_themes = [
311	        {
312	            "id": row["id"],
313	            "title": row["title"],
314	            "status": row["status"],
315	            "sentiment": row["sentiment"],
316	            "health": row["health"],
317	            "description": row["description"],
318	            "last_reinforced_at": _iso(row["last_reinforced_at"]),
319	            "last_active_at": _iso(row["last_active_at"]),
320	            "last_reinforced_at_time": _time_context(row["last_reinforced_at"], user_timezone, now_utc),
321	            "last_active_at_time": _time_context(row["last_active_at"], user_timezone, now_utc),
322	        }
323	        for row in await pool.fetch(
324	            f"""\
325	            SELECT t.id, t.title, t.description, t.status, t.sentiment, t.health, t.last_reinforced_at, t.last_active_at
326	            FROM themes t
327	            {join_artifact_topics('t', '$1')}
328	            WHERE t.status = 'active'
329	            ORDER BY COALESCE(t.last_reinforced_at, t.first_seen_at) DESC
330	            LIMIT 10
331	            """,
332	            primary_topic_id,
333	        )
334	    ]
335	
336	    # Open watch items: owner = user, scoped to primary topic
337	    open_watch_items = [
338	        {
339	            "id": row["id"],
340	            "owner_user_id": row["owner_user_id"],
341	            "content": row["content"],
342	            "due_at": _iso(row["due_at"]),
343	            "due_at_time": _time_context(row["due_at"], user_timezone, now_utc),
344	            "related_theme_ids": _clean_list(row["related_theme_ids"]),
345	        }
346	        for row in await pool.fetch(
347	            f"""\
348	            SELECT w.id, w.owner_user_id, w.content, w.due_at, COALESCE(w.related_theme_ids, '{{}}'::uuid[]) AS related_theme_ids
349	            FROM watch_items w
350	            {join_artifact_topics('w', '$2')}
351	            WHERE w.status = 'open' AND w.owner_user_id = $1
352	            ORDER BY COALESCE(w.due_at, w.created_at) ASC
353	            """,
354	            user.id,
355	            primary_topic_id,
356	        )
357	    ]
358	
359	    # Observations: scoped to primary topic
360	    observations = [
361	        {
362	            "id": row["id"],
363	            "about_user_id": row["about_user_id"],
364	            "content": row["content"],
365	            "confidence": row["confidence"],
366	            "significance": row["significance"],
367	            "related_theme_ids": _clean_list(row["related_theme_ids"]),
368	            "last_reinforced_at": _iso(row["last_reinforced_at"]),
369	            "created_at": _iso(row["created_at"]),
370	            "last_reinforced_at_time": _time_context(row["last_reinforced_at"], user_timezone, now_utc),
371	            "created_at_time": _time_context(row["created_at"], user_timezone, now_utc),
372	        }
373	        for row in await pool.fetch(
374	            f"""\
375	            SELECT o.id, o.about_user_id, o.content, o.confidence, o.significance,
376	                   COALESCE(o.related_theme_ids, '{{}}'::uuid[]) AS related_theme_ids,
377	                   o.last_reinforced_at, o.created_at
378	            FROM observations o
379	            {join_artifact_topics('o', '$1')}
380	            WHERE o.status = 'active' AND o.significance >= 3
381	            ORDER BY recency_weighted_score(o.significance, o.last_reinforced_at, o.created_at) DESC NULLS LAST,
382	                     COALESCE(o.last_reinforced_at, o.created_at) DESC
383	            LIMIT 80
384	            """,
385	            primary_topic_id,
386	        )
387	    ]
388	
389	    # Messages: sender or recipient is the user
390	    message_rows = await pool.fetch(
391	        """\
392	        SELECT id, direction, sender_id, recipient_id, content, media_type, media_duration_seconds,
393	               media_analysis, sent_at, COALESCE(charge, 'routine') AS charge
394	        FROM messages
395	        WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
396	          AND (sender_id = $1 OR recipient_id = $1)
397	        ORDER BY sent_at DESC
398	        LIMIT 20
399	        """,
400	        user.id,
401	    )
402	
403	    # Distillations: scoped to primary topic, source includes user
404	    distillation_rows = await pool.fetch(
405	        f"""\
406	        SELECT d.id, d.content, d.confidence, d.status, d.sensitivity, d.visibility, d.shareable_summary,
407	               COALESCE(d.source_user_ids, '{{}}'::uuid[]) AS source_user_ids,
408	               COALESCE(d.related_memory_ids, '{{}}'::uuid[]) AS related_memory_ids,
409	               COALESCE(d.related_observation_ids, '{{}}'::uuid[]) AS related_observation_ids,
410	               COALESCE(d.related_theme_ids, '{{}}'::uuid[]) AS related_theme_ids,
411	               COALESCE(d.supporting_message_ids, '{{}}'::uuid[]) AS supporting_message_ids,
412	               d.revision_note, d.revision_count, d.updated_at, d.created_at
413	        FROM distillations d
414	        {join_artifact_topics('d', '$2')}
415	        WHERE d.status = 'active'
416	          AND d.source_user_ids && $1::uuid[]
417	        ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC, d.created_at DESC
418	        LIMIT 12
419	        """,
420	        [user.id],
421	        primary_topic_id,
422	    )
423	    distillations: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
424	    for row in distillation_rows:
425	        source_user_ids = _clean_list(row["source_user_ids"])
426	        # For solo, all source material is from this user — always visible
427	        if row["visibility"] == "dyad_shareable" and row["shareable_summary"]:
428	            content = row["shareable_summary"]
429	            display = "shareable_summary"
430	        else:
431	            content = row["content"]
432	            display = "full_content"
433	        distillations.append(
434	            {
435	                "id": row["id"],
436	                "content": content,
437	                "display": display,
438	                "source_user_ids": source_user_ids,
439	                "confidence": row["confidence"],
440	                "sensitivity": row["sensitivity"],
441	                "visibility": row["visibility"],
442	                "revision_count": row["revision_count"],
443	                "related_memory_ids": _clean_list(row["related_memory_ids"]),
444	                "related_observation_ids": _clean_list(row["related_observation_ids"]),
445	                "related_theme_ids": _clean_list(row["related_theme_ids"]),
446	                "supporting_message_ids": _clean_list(row["supporting_message_ids"]),
447	                "updated_at": _iso(row["updated_at"]),
448	                "updated_at_time": _time_context(row["updated_at"], user_timezone, now_utc),
449	            }
450	        )
451	
452	    # Recent messages: only this user's messages, no sharing-default filtering needed
453	    recent_messages = [
454	        {
455	            "id": row["id"],
456	            "direction": row["direction"],
457	            "sender_id": row["sender_id"],
458	            "recipient_id": row["recipient_id"],
459	            "content": row["content"],
460	            "media_type": row["media_type"] if "media_type" in row else None,
461	            "media_duration_seconds": row["media_duration_seconds"] if "media_duration_seconds" in row else None,
462	            "media_analysis": row["media_analysis"] if "media_analysis" in row else None,
463	            "raw_content_hidden": False,
464	            "sent_at": _iso(row["sent_at"]),
465	            "sent_at_time": _time_context(row["sent_at"], user_timezone, now_utc),
466	            "charge": row["charge"],
467	        }
468	        for row in reversed(message_rows)
469	    ]
470	
471	    latest_sent_at = max((row["sent_at"] for row in message_rows), default=None)
472	
473	    # Trigger messages
474	    trigger_rows = await pool.fetch(
475	        """\
476	        SELECT id, direction, sender_id, recipient_id, COALESCE(charge, 'routine') AS charge,
477	               sent_at, content, media_type, media_duration_seconds, media_analysis
478	        FROM messages
479	        WHERE id = ANY($1::uuid[])
480	        ORDER BY sent_at ASC
481	        """,
482	        triggering_message_ids,
483	    )
484	
485	    # Recent reactions (feedback from user about bot's messages)
486	    recent_reactions = [
487	        {
488	            "id": row["id"],
489	            "sentiment": row["sentiment"],
490	            "content": row["content"],
491	            "created_at": _iso(row["created_at"]),
492	            "created_at_time": _time_context(row["created_at"], user_timezone, now_utc),
493	            "message_id": row["message_id"],
494	            "message_content": row["message_content"],
495	            "message_sent_at": _iso(row["message_sent_at"]),
496	            "message_sent_at_time": _time_context(row["message_sent_at"], user_timezone, now_utc),
497	        }
498	        for row in reversed(
499	            await pool.fetch(
500	                """\
501	                WITH previous_turn AS (
502	                    SELECT completed_at
503	                    FROM bot_turns
504	                    WHERE user_in_context = $1
505	                      AND completed_at IS NOT NULL
506	                    ORDER BY completed_at DESC
507	                    LIMIT 1
508	                )
509	                SELECT f.id, f.sentiment, f.content, f.created_at,
510	                       m.id AS message_id, m.content AS message_content, m.sent_at AS message_sent_at
511	                FROM feedback f
512	                JOIN messages m ON m.id = f.target_id
513	                WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM previous_turn)
514	                  AND f.from_user_id = $1
515	                  AND f.target_type = 'message'
516	                  AND f.source = 'reaction'
517	                  AND m.direction = 'outbound'
518	                  AND m.recipient_id = $1
519	                  AND f.created_at > (SELECT completed_at FROM previous_turn)
520	                  AND f.created_at <= $2
521	                ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
522	                LIMIT 5
523	                """,
524	                user.id,
525	                now_utc,
526	            )
527	        )
528	    ]
529	
530	    cross_topic_peek: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
531	    if allow_cross_topic_peek:
532	        peek_since = now_utc - timedelta(days=14)
533	        cross_topic_peek = await peek_other_topics(
534	            pool,
535	            dyad_id=None,
536	            user_id=user.id,
537	            exclude_topic_id=primary_topic_id,
538	            since=peek_since,
539	        )
540	    return HotContextSolo(
541	        current_user=current_user,
542	        partner_user=partner_user,
543	        temporal_context=_temporal_context_solo(user_timezone, now_utc),
544	        conversation_load=conversation_load,
545	        active_oob=active_oob,
546	        memories=memories,
547	        active_themes=active_themes,
548	        open_watch_items=open_watch_items,
549	        observations=observations,
550	        distillations=distillations,
551	        bridge_candidates=[],  # no bridge candidates for solo
552	        recent_reactions=recent_reactions,
553	        recent_messages=recent_messages,
554	        topic_status=topic_status,
555	        cross_topic_peek=cross_topic_peek,
556	        time_since_last_message=_duration_since(latest_sent_at),
557	        trigger_metadata={
558	            **(trigger_metadata or {}),
559	            "triggering_message_ids": triggering_message_ids,
560	            "messages": [
561	                {
562	                    "id": row["id"],
563	                    "charge": row["charge"],
564	                    "sent_at": _iso(row["sent_at"]),
565	                    "sent_at_time": _time_context(row["sent_at"], user_timezone, now_utc),
566	                    "content": row["content"] if "content" in row else None,
567	                    "media_type": row["media_type"] if "media_type" in row else None,
568	                    "media_duration_seconds": row["media_duration_seconds"] if "media_duration_seconds" in row else None,
569	                    "media_analysis": row["media_analysis"] if "media_analysis" in row else None,
570	                }
571	                for row in trigger_rows
572	            ],
573	        },
574	    )
575

581	def _render_solo_with_counts(hc: HotContextSolo, truncations: dict[str, int], clip_limit: int = 240) -> str:
582	    lines: list[str] = []
583	    lines += [
584	        "## You",
585	        f"- id: {_clip(hc.current_user['id'], clip_limit)}",
586	        f"- name: {_clip(hc.current_user['name'], clip_limit)}",
587	        f"- timezone: {_clip(hc.current_user['timezone'], clip_limit)}",
588	        f"- onboarding_state: {_clip(hc.current_user.get('onboarding_state', 'pending'), clip_limit)}",
589	        f"- style_notes: {_clip(hc.current_user.get('style_notes', ''), clip_limit)}",
590	    ]
591	    if hc.temporal_context:
592	        lines += [
593	            "",
594	            "## Current time",
595	            f"- now_utc: {_clip(hc.temporal_context.get('now_utc'), clip_limit)}",
596	            f"- now_local: {_clip(hc.temporal_context.get('now_local'), clip_limit)}",
597	            f"- timezone: {_clip(hc.temporal_context.get('timezone'), clip_limit)}",
598	            f"- local_date: {_clip(hc.temporal_context.get('local_date'), clip_limit)}",
599	            f"- local_time: {_clip(hc.temporal_context.get('local_time'), clip_limit)}",
600	            f"- local_weekday: {_clip(hc.temporal_context.get('local_weekday'), clip_limit)}",
601	            f"- local_day_bounds: {_clip(hc.temporal_context.get('local_day_start'), clip_limit)} to {_clip(hc.temporal_context.get('local_day_end'), clip_limit)} (UTC {_clip(hc.temporal_context.get('local_day_start_utc'), clip_limit)} to {_clip(hc.temporal_context.get('local_day_end_utc'), clip_limit)})",
602	            f"- one_month_from_now: local={_clip(hc.temporal_context.get('one_month_from_now_local'), clip_limit)} utc={_clip(hc.temporal_context.get('one_month_from_now_utc'), clip_limit)} local_date={_clip(hc.temporal_context.get('one_month_from_today_local_date'), clip_limit)}",
603	            "- scheduling_note: Default to scheduling tool delay fields for simple duration phrases like 'in two hours', 'in 10 hours', or 'in two days'. Use local_when for concrete local clock phrases like '9pm tonight' or 'Monday at 8'. Use absolute when only for exact timezone-aware instants. For phrases like 'for the next month', use the one_month_from_now/local_date anchors rather than guessing.",
604	        ]
605	    if not truncations.get("conversation_load"):
606	        lines += [
607	            "",
608	            "## Conversation load",

729	    """Render a solo HotContextSolo as a string, respecting the token budget.
730	
731	    Mirrors render_hot_context but skips all partner/bridge/sharing-default
732	    sections.
733	    """
734	    budget = get_settings().hot_context_token_budget
735	    working = HotContextSolo(
736	        current_user=hc.current_user,
737	        partner_user=hc.partner_user,

751	        time_since_last_message=hc.time_since_last_message,
752	        trigger_metadata=hc.trigger_metadata,
753	    )
754	    truncations = {"distillations": 0, "observations": 0, "memories": 0, "recent_messages": 0, "conversation_load": 0}
755	    clip_limit = 240
756	    text = _render_solo_with_counts(working, truncations, clip_limit)
757	    for name in ("distillations", "observations", "memories", "recent_messages"):
758	        items = getattr(working, name)
759	        while _estimated_tokens(text) > budget and items:
760	            items.pop()
761	            truncations[name] += 1
762	            text = _render_solo_with_counts(working, truncations, clip_limit)
763	    for clip_limit in (160, 100, 60, 30):
764	        if _estimated_tokens(text) <= budget:
765	            break
766	        text = _render_solo_with_counts(working, truncations, clip_limit)
767	    for name in ("open_watch_items", "active_themes"):
768	        items = getattr(working, name)
769	        while _estimated_tokens(text) > budget and items:
770	            items.pop()
771	            text = _render_solo_with_counts(working, truncations, clip_limit)
772	    if _estimated_tokens(text) > budget and not truncations["conversation_load"]:
773	        truncations["conversation_load"] = 1
774	        text = _render_solo_with_counts(working, truncations, clip_limit)
775	    return text

1	"""Topic-filter helper for the artifact_topics join cutover (Sprint 3).
2	
3	Single function ``join_artifact_topics`` that emits a JOIN fragment for
4	scoping artifact-table reads to a specific topic.  Every read of memories /
5	themes / observations / watch_items / distillations / out_of_bounds must go
6	through this join so topic-scoped queries leverage the partial index
7	``idx_artifact_topics_topic_artifact_active``.
8	"""
9	
10	from __future__ import annotations
11	
12	# Six canonical aliases → artifact_table values
13	_ALIAS_MAP: dict[str, str] = {
14	    "m": "memories",
15	    "t": "themes",
16	    "o": "observations",
17	    "w": "watch_items",
18	    "d": "distillations",
19	    "x": "out_of_bounds",
20	}
21	
22	
23	def join_artifact_topics(table_alias: str, topic_id_param: str) -> str:
24	    """Return a JOIN fragment that filters *table_alias* to *topic_id_param*.
25	
26	    Parameters
27	    ----------
28	    table_alias:
29	        Single-character alias identifying the artifact table
30	        (``m``, ``t``, ``o``, ``w``, ``d``, ``x``).
31	    topic_id_param:
32	        The parameter placeholder that receives the topic UUID at
33	        execution time, e.g. ``"$3"``.  Callers using **append-last**
34	        binding must pass the *final* positional index here.
35	
36	    Returns
37	    -------
38	    str
39	        SQL fragment: ``JOIN artifact_topics _at_<alias> ...``
40	
41	    Raises
42	    ------
43	    TypeError
44	        If *topic_id_param* is ``None`` (must be an explicit bind like ``"$4"``).
45	    ValueError
46	        If *table_alias* is not one of the six recognised aliases.
47	    """
48	    if table_alias not in _ALIAS_MAP:
49	        raise ValueError(
50	            f"Unknown artifact-table alias {table_alias!r}; "
51	            f"expected one of {sorted(_ALIAS_MAP)}"
52	        )
53	    if topic_id_param is None:
54	        raise TypeError(
55	            "topic_id_param must be a string like '$4', not None. "
56	            "Pass the final positional bind index so the caller controls "
57	            "append-last ordering."
58	        )
59	
60	    table = _ALIAS_MAP[table_alias]
61	    prefix = f"_at_{table_alias}"
62	
63	    return (
64	        f"JOIN artifact_topics {prefix}"
65	        f" ON {prefix}.artifact_table = '{table}'"
66	        f" AND {prefix}.artifact_id = {table_alias}.id"
67	        f" AND {prefix}.topic_id = {topic_id_param}"
68	        f" AND {prefix}.status = 'active'"
69	    )

255	def _broad_topic(entry: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
256	    text = f"{entry.get('shareable_context') or ''} {entry.get('sensitive_core') or ''}".lower()
257	    keyword_topics = [
258	        ("family history", ("family", "mother", "father", "parent", "sibling", "childhood")),
259	        ("past relationships", ("ex", "past relationship", "former partner", "dating")),
260	        ("health", ("health", "medical", "illness", "therapy", "diagnosis")),
261	        ("finances", ("money", "debt", "salary", "finance", "financial")),
262	        ("work", ("work", "job", "boss", "career")),
263	        ("children", ("child", "kid", "children")),
264	        ("parenting", ("parenting", "co-parent")),
265	        ("religion", ("religion", "faith", "church", "spiritual")),
266	        ("politics", ("politics", "political", "election")),
267	        ("trauma", ("trauma", "abuse", "assault")),
268	    ]
269	    for topic, keywords in keyword_topics:
270	        if any(keyword in text for keyword in keywords):
271	            return topic
272	    return "personal matter"

279	        return "a personal matter"

321	async def summarize_partner_oob(
322	    pool: Any,
323	    *,
324	    owner_id: UUID,
325	    client: Any | None = None,
326	    topic_id: UUID | None = None,
327	) -> SummarizeOOBTopicsOutput:
328	    """Return non-identifying counts and broad topic clusters for active OOB entries."""
329	    topic = topic_id or get_relationship_topic_id()
330	    if topic is None:
331	        raise RuntimeError("summarize_partner_oob: no topic_id provided and relationship topic not available")
332	    entries = await _active_oob_entries(pool, [owner_id], topic_id=topic)
333	    if not entries:
334	        return SummarizeOOBTopicsOutput(total_count=0, clusters=[], narrative="no active out-of-bounds entries")
335	
336	    deterministic_topics = [_broad_topic(entry) for entry in entries]
337	    topics = deterministic_topics
338	    if len(entries) > 1 and any(topic == "personal matter" for topic in deterministic_topics):
339	        topics = await _cluster_topics_with_haiku(pool, entries, client) or deterministic_topics
340	
341	    raw_counts = Counter(topics)
342	    safe_counts: Counter[str] = Counter()
343	    for topic, count in raw_counts.items():
344	        safe_counts[_safe_topic(topic, count)] += count
345	
346	    clusters = [
347	        OOBTopicCluster(count=count, topic=topic)
348	        for topic, count in sorted(safe_counts.items(), key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]))
349	    ]
350	    parts = [f"{_count_word(cluster.count)} {'entry' if cluster.count == 1 else 'entries'} related to {cluster.topic}" for cluster in clusters]
351	    if len(parts) == 1:
352	        narrative = parts[0]
353	    else:
354	        narrative = ", ".join(parts[:-1]) + f", and {parts[-1]}"
355	    return SummarizeOOBTopicsOutput(total_count=len(entries), clusters=clusters, narrative=narrative)

19	SCORING_PROMPT_VERSION = "v1"
20	FAILED_SCORING_PROMPT_VERSION = "v1-failed"
21	SCORING_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 30
22	
23	_SCORING_INSTRUCTIONS = """Score a relationship observation's significance on a 1-5 scale.
24	
25	Return JSON only with this shape:
26	{"score":1,"reason":"short explanation"}
27	
28	Anchor examples:
29	1 - Trivial. Marginal pattern, weak evidence, low relevance even if true.
30	Example: "He uses slightly more emojis on weekends."
31	2 - Minor. Real but small. Worth recording, not worth surfacing proactively.
32	Example: "She tends to send longer messages in the morning."
33	3 - Notable. Solid pattern with real relevance to how they relate. Worth surfacing when relevant context arises.
34	Example: "He brings up work frustration before getting sharp with her."
35	4 - Significant. Strong pattern materially affecting how the relationship functions. Should actively inform engagement.
36	Example: "Their conflicts cool faster when she initiates the repair; much slower when he does."
37	5 - Core. Defining pattern of the relationship dynamic. Always-on context.
38	Example: "Long walks have been their primary reconnection mechanism for years; it is how they consistently repair."
39	"""
40	
41	
42	class RescoreReport(NamedTuple):
43	    scanned: int
44	    rescored: int
45	    still_failed: int
46	
47	
48	def _attr(obj: Any, name: str, default: Any = None) -> Any:
49	    if isinstance(obj, dict):
50	        return obj.get(name, default)
51	    return getattr(obj, name, default)
52	
53	
54	def _usage_tokens(usage: Any, field: str) -> int:
55	    return int(_attr(usage, field, 0) or 0)
56	
57	
58	async def _record_response_cost(pool: Any, usage: Any) -> None:
59	    settings = get_settings()
60	    input_tokens = _usage_tokens(usage, "input_tokens")
61	    cache_create = _usage_tokens(usage, "cache_creation_input_tokens")
62	    cache_read = _usage_tokens(usage, "cache_read_input_tokens")
63	    output_tokens = _usage_tokens(usage, "output_tokens")
64	    regular_input_tokens = max(0, input_tokens - cache_create - cache_read)
65	    dollars = (
66	        regular_input_tokens * settings.anthropic_haiku_input_usd_per_mtok
67	        + cache_create * settings.anthropic_haiku_input_usd_per_mtok * 1.25
68	        + cache_read * settings.anthropic_haiku_input_usd_per_mtok * 0.10
69	        + output_tokens * settings.anthropic_haiku_output_usd_per_mtok
70	    ) / 1_000_000
71	    if dollars > 0:
72	        await record_llm_cost(pool, "text", dollars)
73	
74	
75	def _response_text(response: Any) -> str:
76	    parts: list[str] = []
77	    for block in _attr(response, "content", []) or []:
78	        if _attr(block, "type") == "text":
79	            parts.append(str(_attr(block, "text", "")))
80	    return "\n".join(part for part in parts if part).strip()
81	
82	
83	def _failure(reason: str) -> tuple[None, str, str]:
84	    return None, f"scoring failed: {reason}", FAILED_SCORING_PROMPT_VERSION
85	
86	
87	def _parse_score(text: str) -> tuple[int, str]:
88	    data = json.loads(text)
89	    score = int(data["score"])
90	    if score < 1 or score > 5:
91	        raise ValueError(f"score out of range: {score}")
92	    reason = str(data.get("reason") or "").strip()
93	    if not reason:
94	        raise ValueError("missing reason")
95	    return score, reason
96	
97	
98	async def score_observation(
99	    pool: Any,
100	    *,
101	    content: str,
102	    client: Any | None = None,
103	) -> tuple[int | None, str, str]:
104	    """Return `(score, reason, prompt_version)` or `(None, reason, 'v1-failed')`."""
105	    settings = get_settings()
106	    if client is None:
107	        client = anthropic.AsyncAnthropic([REDACTED]())
108	
109	    try:
110	        if not await is_under_cap(pool, "text"):
111	            raise RuntimeError("text LLM spend cap exceeded")
112	        async with asyncio.timeout(SCORING_TIMEOUT_SECONDS):
113	            response = await client.messages.create(
114	                model=settings.scoring_model,
115	                max_tokens=300,
116	                system=[{"type": "text", "text": _SCORING_INSTRUCTIONS, "cache_control": {"type": "ephemeral"}}],
117	                messages=[{"role": "user", "content": json.dumps({"observation": content})}],
118	            )
119	        await _record_response_cost(pool, _attr(response, "usage", {}))
120	        score, reason = _parse_score(_response_text(response))
121	    except Exception as exc:
122	        logger.warning("observation scoring failed: %s", exc)
123	        return _failure(str(exc))
124	    return score, reason, SCORING_PROMPT_VERSION
125	
126	
127	async def rescore_observations(
128	    pool: Any,
129	    *,
130	    prompt_version_threshold: str = SCORING_PROMPT_VERSION,
131	    client: Any | None = None,
132	    topic_id: UUID | None = None,
133	) -> RescoreReport:
134	    """Manually re-score observations with missing, failed, flagged, or older prompt versions."""
135	    topic = topic_id or get_relationship_topic_id()
136	    if topic is None:
137	        raise RuntimeError("rescore_observations: no topic_id provided and relationship topic not available")
138	    rows = await pool.fetch(
139	        f"""
140	        SELECT o.id, o.content
141	        FROM observations o
142	        {join_artifact_topics('o', '$2')}
143	        WHERE (o.scoring_prompt_version IS NULL
144	           OR o.scoring_prompt_version < $1
145	           OR o.scoring_prompt_version LIKE '%failed'
146	           OR o.needs_rescoring = true)
147	        ORDER BY o.created_at
148	        """,
149	        prompt_version_threshold, topic,
150	    )
151	    rescored = 0
152	    still_failed = 0
153	    for row in rows:
154	        score, _reason, prompt_version = await score_observation(pool, content=row["content"], client=client)
155	        await pool.execute(
156	            """
157	            UPDATE observations
158	            SET significance = $1,
159	                scoring_prompt_version = $2,
160	                last_reinforced_at = COALESCE(last_reinforced_at, now()),
161	                needs_rescoring = CASE WHEN $1::integer IS NULL THEN needs_rescoring ELSE false END
162	            WHERE id = $3
163	            """,
164	            score,
165	            prompt_version,
166	            row["id"],
167	        )
168	        if score is None:
169	            still_failed += 1
170	        else:
171	            rescored += 1
172	    return RescoreReport(scanned=len(rows), rescored=rescored, still_failed=still_failed)

224	async def _record_response_cost(pool: Any, usage: Any) -> None:
225	    settings = get_settings()
226	    input_price = settings.anthropic_input_usd_per_mtok
227	    output_price = settings.anthropic_output_usd_per_mtok
228	    input_tokens = _usage_tokens(usage, "input_tokens")
229	    cache_create = _usage_tokens(usage, "cache_creation_input_tokens")
230	    cache_read = _usage_tokens(usage, "cache_read_input_tokens")
231	    output_tokens = _usage_tokens(usage, "output_tokens")
232	    regular_input_tokens = max(0, input_tokens - cache_create - cache_read)
233	    dollars = (
234	        regular_input_tokens * input_price
235	        + cache_create * input_price * 1.25
236	        + cache_read * input_price * 0.10
237	        + output_tokens * output_price
238	    ) / 1_000_000
239	    await record_llm_cost(pool, "text", dollars)

242	async def _create_message_with_retry(
243	    client: Any,
244	    *,
245	    ctx: TurnContext,
246	    system: list[dict[str, Any]],
247	    tools: list[dict[str, Any]],
248	    messages: list[dict[str, Any]],
249	    model: str | None = None,
250	    max_tokens: int = 1200,
251	) -> Any:
252	    settings = get_settings()
253	    last_error: Exception | None = None
254	    for attempt in range(2):
255	        if not await is_under_cap(ctx.pool, "text"):
256	            raise SpendCapExceeded("text LLM spend cap exceeded")
257	        try:
258	            response = await client.messages.create(
259	                model=model or settings.conversational_model,
260	                max_tokens=max_tokens,
261	                system=system,
262	                messages=messages,
263	                tools=tools,
264	            )
265	        except Exception as exc:  # Anthropic SDK transient subclasses vary by version.
266	            last_error = exc
267	            if attempt == 0:
268	                logger.warning("anthropic message create failed; retrying once: %s", exc, extra=obs_fields(ctx))
269	                continue
270	            raise LLMPhaseError(str(exc)) from exc
271	        await _record_response_cost(ctx.pool, _attr(response, "usage", {}))
272	        return response
273	    raise LLMPhaseError(str(last_error or "anthropic message create failed"))

309	        tool_uses = [block for block in content_blocks if block.get("type") == "tool_use"]
310	        if not tool_uses or _attr(response, "stop_reason") != "tool_use":
311	            final_text = "\n".join(

317	
318	        tool_iteration_count += 1
319	        if max_tool_iterations is not None and tool_iteration_count > max_tool_iterations:

321	        tool_results: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

383	    if not note:
384	        return
385	    existing = await pool.fetchval("SELECT COALESCE(reasoning, '') FROM bot_turns WHERE id=$1", turn_id)
386	    updated = f"{existing or ''}\n{note}"
387	    await pool.execute(
388	        "UPDATE bot_turns SET reasoning=$1, reasoning_encrypted=$2 WHERE id=$3",
389	        updated,
390	        encrypt_value(updated),
391	        turn_id,
392	    )

395	def _extract_reaction_directive(text: str) -> tuple[str | None, str]:
396	    emoji: str | None = None
397	    kept_lines: list[str] = []
398	    for raw_line in text.splitlines():
399	        match = REACTION_DIRECTIVE_RE.match(raw_line)
400	        if match and emoji is None:
401	            emoji = match.group("emoji").strip()
402	            continue
403	        kept_lines.append(raw_line)
404	    return emoji, "\n".join(kept_lines).strip()

407	async def _react_to_triggering_message(pool: Any, user: User, triggering_message_ids: list[UUID], emoji: str) -> bool:
408	    settings = get_settings()
409	    if settings.messaging_provider.strip().lower() != "discord" or not triggering_message_ids:
410	        return False
411	    row = await pool.fetchrow(
412	        """
413	        SELECT whatsapp_message_id
414	        FROM messages
415	        WHERE id=$1 AND direction='inbound' AND sender_id=$2
416	        """,
417	        triggering_message_ids[-1],
418	        user.id,
419	    )
420	    if row is None or not row.get("whatsapp_message_id"):
421	        return False
422	    await discord.add_reaction(user.phone, row["whatsapp_message_id"], emoji)
423	    return True

426	async def _check_outbound_oob(
427	    pool: Any,
428	    content: str,
429	    recipient_id: UUID,
430	    protected_owner_ids: list[UUID] | None = None,
431	) -> dict[str, Any]:
432	    hook = hooks.check_oob
433	    if hook is None:
434	        return {"verdict": "ok", "reason": "OOB hook disabled", "suggested_rewrite": None, "checker_failed": False}
435	    try:
436	        verdict = await hook(pool, content, recipient_id, protected_owner_ids=protected_owner_ids)
437	    except TypeError:
438	        try:
439	            verdict = await hook(pool, content, recipient_id)
440	        except TypeError:
441	            verdict = await hook(content, recipient_id)
442	    if hasattr(verdict, "model_dump"):
443	        verdict = verdict.model_dump(mode="json")
444	    verdict.setdefault("suggested_rewrite", verdict.get("rewrite"))
445	    verdict.setdefault("reason", "")
446	    verdict.setdefault("checker_failed", False)
447	    return verdict
448	
449	
450	async def _resolve_outbound_text(
451	    pool: Any,
452	    turn_id: UUID,
453	    user: User,
454	    content: str,
455	    protected_owner_ids: list[UUID] | None = None,
456	) -> str | None:
457	    verdict = await _check_outbound_oob(pool, content, user.id, protected_owner_ids)
458	    if verdict["verdict"] == "ok":
459	        if verdict.get("checker_failed"):
460	            await _append_reasoning(pool, turn_id, f"OOB checker failed open before send: {verdict['reason']}")
461	        return content
462	    if verdict["verdict"] == "block":
463	        await _append_reasoning(pool, turn_id, f"Outbound blocked before send by OOB checker: {verdict['reason']}")
464	        return None
465	    suggested = (verdict.get("suggested_rewrite") or "").strip()
466	    if not suggested:
467	        await _append_reasoning(pool, turn_id, f"Outbound rewrite requested but no rewrite was supplied: {verdict['reason']}")
468	        return None
469	    second = await _check_outbound_oob(pool, suggested, user.id, protected_owner_ids)
470	    if second["verdict"] != "ok":
471	        await _append_reasoning(
472	            pool,
473	            turn_id,
474	            f"Outbound rewrite was not sendable: first={verdict['reason']} second={second['reason']}",
475	        )
476	        return None
477	    await _append_reasoning(pool, turn_id, f"Outbound rewritten by OOB checker before send: {verdict['reason']}")
478	    return suggested

481	async def _open_turn(
482	    pool: Any,
483	    triggering_message_ids: list[UUID],
484	    user: User,
485	    prompt_snapshot: str,
486	    model_version: str,
487	    system_prompt_version: str,
488	    *,
489	    bot_id: str,
490	    topic_id: UUID | None,
491	    bot_spec_version: str,
492	    hot_context_builder_version: str,
493	    tool_schema_version: str,
494	) -> tuple[UUID, datetime]:
495	    row = await pool.fetchrow(
496	        """
497	        INSERT INTO bot_turns (
498	            triggered_by_message_id, triggering_message_ids, user_in_context,
499	            system_prompt_version, model_version, prompt_snapshot, prompt_snapshot_encrypted, started_at,
500	            bot_id, topic_id, bot_spec_version, hot_context_builder_version, tool_schema_version
501	        )
502	        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, now(), $8, $9, $10, $11, $12)
503	        RETURNING id, started_at
504	        """,
505	        triggering_message_ids[0] if triggering_message_ids else None,
506	        triggering_message_ids,
507	        user.id,
508	        system_prompt_version,
509	        model_version,
510	        prompt_snapshot,
511	        encrypt_value(prompt_snapshot),
512	        bot_id,
513	        topic_id,
514	        bot_spec_version,
515	        hot_context_builder_version,
516	        tool_schema_version,
517	    )
518	    try:
519	        started_at = row["started_at"]
520	    except KeyError:
521	        started_at = datetime.now(UTC)
522	    return row["id"], started_at

589	async def _defer_for_text_cap(pool: Any, user: User, message_ids: list[UUID], *, bot_id: str | None = None, topic_id: UUID | None = None) -> bool:
590	    if message_ids:
591	        await pool.execute(
592	            "UPDATE messages SET processing_state='deferred' WHERE id = ANY($1)",
593	            message_ids,
594	        )
595	    context_payload: dict[str, Any] = {
596	        "triggering_message_ids": [str(message_id) for message_id in message_ids],
597	        "reason": "text_spend_cap",
598	    }
599	    if bot_id is not None:
600	        context_payload["bot_id"] = bot_id
601	    if topic_id is not None:
602	        context_payload["topic_id"] = str(topic_id)
603	    row = await pool.fetchrow(
604	        """
605	        INSERT INTO scheduled_jobs (user_id, job_type, scheduled_for, context, status, bot_id, topic_id)
606	        SELECT $1, 'deferred_turn', $2, $3::jsonb, 'pending', $4, $5
607	        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
608	            SELECT 1 FROM scheduled_jobs
609	            WHERE user_id = $1 AND job_type = 'deferred_turn' AND status = 'pending'
610	        )
611	        RETURNING id, scheduled_for
612	        """,
613	        user.id,
614	        datetime.now(UTC) + timedelta(days=1),
615	        context_payload,
616	        bot_id,
617	        topic_id,
618	    )
619	    return row is not None

622	async def _newer_inbound_exists(
623	    pool: Any,
624	    user: User,
625	    triggering_message_ids: list[UUID],
626	    *,
627	    fallback_started_at: datetime | None = None,
628	    bot_id: str,
629	) -> bool:
630	    boundary = fallback_started_at
631	    if triggering_message_ids:
632	        trigger_boundary = await pool.fetchval(
633	            "SELECT MAX(sent_at) FROM messages WHERE id = ANY($1::uuid[])",
634	            triggering_message_ids,
635	        )
636	        if trigger_boundary is not None:
637	            boundary = trigger_boundary
638	    if boundary is None:
639	        return False
640	    return bool(
641	        await pool.fetchval(
642	            """
643	            SELECT EXISTS (
644	                SELECT 1
645	                FROM messages
646	                WHERE direction='inbound'
647	                  AND sender_id=$1
648	                  AND sent_at > $2
649	                  AND NOT (id = ANY($3::uuid[]))
650	                  AND bot_id = $4
651	            )
652	            """,
653	            user.id,
654	            boundary,
655	            triggering_message_ids,
656	            bot_id,
657	        )
658	    )
659	
660	
661	STEP_ITERATION_CAPS = {
662	    "read": 6,
663	    "consult": 1,
664	    "respond": 4,
665	    "record": 8,
666	    "schedule": 4,
667	    "done": 0,
668	}
669

671	def _allowed_tools_for_step(ctx: TurnContext) -> set[str]:
672	    allowed = set(STEP_ALLOWED_TOOLS.get(ctx.current_step, set())) | {"update_turn_plan"}
673	    if ctx.current_step == "respond" and not ctx.incremental_sending_enabled:
674	        allowed.discard("send_message_part")
675	    return allowed

679	    if delivered_parts:

682	            f"{'' if len(delivered_parts) == 1 else 's'}:\n"
683	            + "\n\n".join(f"{idx + 1}. {content}" for idx, content in enumerate(delivered_parts))
684	        )
685	    return f"You sent: {f'[reaction {reaction_emoji}]' if reaction_emoji else (assistant_text or '[silence]')}"

696	async def _run_agentic(
697	    triggering_message_ids: list[UUID],
698	    user: User,
699	    *,
700	    trigger_metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
701	    pool: Any | None = None,
702	    prompt_version: str | None = None,
703	    before_paced_send: BeforePacedSend | None = None,
704	) -> None:
705	    active_pool = pool or _pool
706	    if active_pool is not None and await system_state.is_paused(active_pool):
707	        return
708	    if active_pool is None:
709	        raise RuntimeError("agentic pool has not been set")
710	
711	    settings = get_settings()
712	    bot_spec = get_bot_spec(settings.bot_id)
713	    primary_topic_id = await primary_topic_id_for(active_pool, bot_spec)
714	    selected_prompt_version = prompt_version or settings.system_prompt_version
715	    send_typing_indicator = not bool(trigger_metadata and trigger_metadata.get("pacing"))
716	    turn_id: UUID | None = None
717	    started_at = datetime.now(UTC)
718	    responded_to_user = False
719	    try:
720	        if bot_spec.participants_shape == "solo":
721	            partner = None
722	            hot_context = await build_hot_context_solo(
723	                active_pool, user, triggering_message_ids, trigger_metadata,
724	                primary_topic_id=primary_topic_id, bot_id=bot_spec.bot_id,
725	                allow_cross_topic_peek=getattr(bot_spec.read_scopes, 'allow_cross_topic_peek', False),
726	            )
727	            rendered_hot_context = render_hot_context_solo(hot_context)
728	        else:
729	            partner = await partner_of(active_pool, user)
730	            hot_context = await build_hot_context(
731	                active_pool, user, partner, triggering_message_ids, trigger_metadata,
732	                primary_topic_id=primary_topic_id,
733	                allow_cross_topic_peek=getattr(bot_spec.read_scopes, 'allow_cross_topic_peek', False),
734	                allow_cross_topic_status_injection=getattr(bot_spec.read_scopes, 'allow_cross_topic_status_injection', False),
735	            )
736	            rendered_hot_context = render_hot_context(hot_context)
737	        system_prompt = bot_spec.render_system_prompt(
738	            assistant_name=settings.assistant_name,
739	            user=user,
740	            partner=partner,
741	            prompt_version=selected_prompt_version,
742	        )
743	        prompt_snapshot = f"{system_prompt}\n\n{rendered_hot_context}"
744	        bot_spec_version = hashlib.sha1(repr(bot_spec).encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
745	        turn_id, started_at = await _open_turn(
746	            active_pool,
747	            triggering_message_ids,
748	            user,
749	            prompt_snapshot,
750	            settings.conversational_model,
751	            selected_prompt_version,
752	            bot_id=bot_spec.bot_id,
753	            topic_id=primary_topic_id,
754	            bot_spec_version=bot_spec_version,
755	            hot_context_builder_version=bot_spec.hot_context_builder_version,
756	            tool_schema_version=_TOOL_SCHEMA_VERSION,
757	        )
758	        await record_turn_event(
759	            active_pool,
760	            turn_id,
761	            "turn.opened",
762	            metadata={
763	                "triggered_by_message_id": triggering_message_ids[0] if triggering_message_ids else None,
764	                "triggering_message_count": len(triggering_message_ids),
765	                "user_in_context": user.id,
766	                "model_version": settings.conversational_model,
767	                "system_prompt_version": selected_prompt_version,
768	                "bot_id": bot_spec.bot_id,
769	                "topic_id": str(primary_topic_id) if primary_topic_id else None,
770	                "channel_id": None,
771	                "binding_id": None,
772	            },
773	        )
774	        charge = _trigger_charge(hot_context)
775	        explicit_partner_alert_requested = _explicit_partner_alert_requested(hot_context)
776	        hot_context_signals = _build_hot_context_signals(hot_context)
777	        skeleton_name = pick_default_skeleton(
778	            trigger_metadata=hot_context.trigger_metadata,
779	            charge=charge,
780	            hot_context_signals=hot_context_signals,
781	        )
782	        turn_plan = make_turn_plan(skeleton_name)
783	        ctx = TurnContext(
784	            turn_id,
785	            active_pool,
786	            user,
787	            partner,
788	            triggering_message_ids,
789	            bot_id=bot_spec.bot_id,
790	            bot_spec=bot_spec,
791	            binding_id=None,
792	            dyad_id=None,
793	            participants_shape=bot_spec.participants_shape,
794	            primary_topic_id=primary_topic_id,
795	            primary_topic_slug=bot_spec.primary_topic_slug,
796	            channel_id=None,
797	            read_scopes=bot_spec.read_scopes,
798	            write_scopes=bot_spec.write_scopes,
799	            cross_topic_policy=bot_spec.cross_topic_policy,
800	            current_step=turn_plan.current,
801	            turn_plan=turn_plan,
802	            trigger_charge=charge,
803	            explicit_partner_alert_requested=explicit_partner_alert_requested,
804	            turn_started_at=started_at,
805	            incremental_sending_enabled=(
806	                settings.messaging_provider.strip().lower() == "discord"
807	                and settings.discord_multi_message_enabled
808	            ),
809	            protected_owner_ids=[user.id] if partner is None else [user.id, partner.id],
810	            send_typing_indicator=send_typing_indicator,
811	            before_paced_send=before_paced_send,
812	            sent_message_parts=[],
813	            hot_context_rendered=rendered_hot_context,
814	            trigger_metadata=hot_context.trigger_metadata,
815	        )
816	        seed_messages = bot_spec.build_initial_seed(
817	            trigger_metadata=hot_context.trigger_metadata,
818	            triggering_message_ids=triggering_message_ids,
819	            charge=charge,
820	            orient_header=orient_summary(
821	                trigger_metadata=hot_context.trigger_metadata,
822	                charge=charge,
823	                hot_context_signals=hot_context_signals,
824	            ),
825	            plan=turn_plan,
826	        )
827	        messages = seed_messages
828	        tool_call_count = 0
829	        assistant_text = ""
830	        respond_text = ""
831	        reaction_emoji: str | None = None
832	        sent_summary_for_record: str | None = None
833	        final_output_message_id: UUID | None = None
834	        reasoning_parts: list[str] = []
835	        delivered_parts: list[str] = []
836	
837	        while turn_plan.current != "done":
838	            ctx.current_step = turn_plan.current
839	            step_started_at = datetime.now(UTC)
840	            await record_turn_event(
841	                active_pool,
842	                turn_id,
843	                "step.started",
844	                step=ctx.current_step,
845	                metadata={"skeleton_name": turn_plan.skeleton_name},
846	            )
847	            try:
848	                step_text, messages, step_tool_count = await run_step(
849	                    None,
850	                    ctx,
851	                    system_prompt,
852	                    rendered_hot_context,
853	                    _allowed_tools_for_step(ctx),
854	                    messages,
855	                    max_tool_iterations=STEP_ITERATION_CAPS.get(ctx.current_step, 4),
856	                )
857	            except Exception as exc:
858	                await record_turn_event(
859	                    active_pool,
860	                    turn_id,
861	                    "step.failed",
862	                    step=ctx.current_step,
863	                    severity="error",
864	                    duration_ms=max(0, int((datetime.now(UTC) - step_started_at).total_seconds() * 1000)),
865	                    metadata={"exception_type": type(exc).__name__},
866	                )
867	                raise
868	            await record_turn_event(
869	                active_pool,
870	                turn_id,
871	                "step.completed",
872	                step=ctx.current_step,
873	                duration_ms=max(0, int((datetime.now(UTC) - step_started_at).total_seconds() * 1000)),
874	                metadata={"tool_call_count": step_tool_count, "assistant_text_present": bool(step_text)},
875	            )
876	            tool_call_count += step_tool_count
877	
878	            if ctx.current_step == "respond":
879	                assistant_text = step_text
880	                if triggering_message_ids:
881	                    await active_pool.execute(
882	                        "UPDATE messages SET processing_state='processed' WHERE id = ANY($1) AND processing_state='raw'",
883	                        triggering_message_ids,
884	                    )
885	
886	                sent_parts = ctx.sent_message_parts or []
887	                final_output_message_id = sent_parts[-1]["message_id"] if sent_parts else final_output_message_id
888	                responded_to_user = responded_to_user or bool(sent_parts)
889	                if sent_parts and assistant_text:
890	                    await _append_reasoning(
891	                        active_pool,
892	                        turn_id,
893	                        "Suppressed final respond text because send_message_part already delivered user-visible text.",
894	                    )
895	                    assistant_text = ""
896	                elif assistant_text:
897	                    assistant_text = clean_user_facing_text(assistant_text)
898	                    reaction_emoji, assistant_text = _extract_reaction_directive(assistant_text)
899	                    if reaction_emoji is not None:
900	                        if await _react_to_triggering_message(active_pool, user, triggering_message_ids, reaction_emoji):
901	                            await _append_reasoning(active_pool, turn_id, f"Reacted to triggering message with {reaction_emoji}.")
902	                            await claim_onboarding_welcome(active_pool, user.id)
903	                            responded_to_user = True
904	                    if assistant_text:
905	                        dyad_owner_ids = ctx.protected_owner_ids
906	                        sendable_text = await _resolve_outbound_text(active_pool, turn_id, user, assistant_text, dyad_owner_ids)
907	                        already_sent = [part["content"] for part in sent_parts]
908	                        if sendable_text is None:
909	                            await record_turn_event(
910	                                active_pool,
911	                                turn_id,
912	                                "outbound.withheld",
913	                                step=ctx.current_step,
914	                                severity="warning",
915	                                actor="delivery",
916	                                message="Final outbound was not sendable after safety checks.",
917	                                metadata={"reason": "safety_check"},
918	                            )
919	                        elif sendable_text and sendable_text not in already_sent:
920	                            if await _newer_inbound_exists(
921	                                active_pool,
922	                                user,
923	                                triggering_message_ids,
924	                                fallback_started_at=started_at,
925	                                bot_id=ctx.bot_id,
926	                            ):
927	                                await _append_reasoning(
928	                                    active_pool,
929	                                    turn_id,
930	                                    "Final outbound skipped because a newer inbound message arrived before send.",
931	                                )
932	                                await record_turn_event(
933	                                    active_pool,
934	                                    turn_id,
935	                                    "outbound.withheld",
936	                                    step=ctx.current_step,
937	                                    severity="warning",
938	                                    actor="delivery",
939	                                    message="Final outbound skipped because a newer inbound arrived.",
940	                                    metadata={"reason": "newer_inbound_before_send"},
941	                                )
942	                                assistant_text = ""
943	                            else:
944

127	def _emoji_terms(value: str) -> set[str]:
128	    terms = {token for token in re.split(r"[^a-z0-9]+", value.lower()) if token}
129	    expanded = set(terms)
130	    for term in terms:
131	        expanded.update(_EMOJI_QUERY_EXPANSIONS.get(term, set()))
132	    return expanded

135	def _emoji_score(query_terms: set[str], name: str, aliases: list[str], keywords: list[str]) -> int:
136	    haystacks = [name, *aliases, *keywords]
137	    score = 0
138	    for term in query_terms:
139	        for idx, haystack in enumerate(haystacks):
140	            normalized = haystack.lower().replace("_", " ").replace("-", " ")
141	            if term == normalized:
142	                score += 12 if idx == 0 else 8
143	            elif term in _emoji_terms(normalized):
144	                score += 6 if idx == 0 else 4
145	            elif term in normalized:
146	                score += 2
147	    return score

316	        )
317	    if args.local_day is not None:
318	        start, end = local_day_bounds_utc(args.local_day, _ctx_timezone(ctx, args.timezone), now=_ctx_now(ctx))
319	        params.extend([start, end])
320	        clauses.append(f"sent_at >= ${len(params) - 1}")
321	        clauses.append(f"sent_at < ${len(params)}")
322	    else:
323	        add_date_range(clauses, params, "sent_at", args.date_range)
324	    params.append(args.limit)
325	    rows = await ctx.pool.fetch(
326	        f"""
327	        SELECT id, sender_id, recipient_id, sent_at, content, media_type, media_analysis,
328	               COALESCE(charge, 'routine') AS charge, direction
329	        FROM messages
330	        WHERE {' AND '.join(clauses)}
331	        ORDER BY sent_at DESC
332	        LIMIT ${len(params)}
333	        """,
334	        *params,
335	    )
336	    sharing_defaults = {
337	        ctx.user.id: normalize_sharing_default(ctx.user.cross_thread_sharing_default),
338	        ctx.partner.id: normalize_sharing_default(ctx.partner.cross_thread_sharing_default),
339	    }
340	    hits = []
341	    for row in rows:
342	        owner_id = _message_thread_owner_id(row)
343	        if owner_id not in dyad_ids:
344	            continue
345	        if not raw_message_visibility(
346	            viewer_user_id=ctx.user.id,
347	            thread_owner_user_id=owner_id,
348	            thread_owner_sharing_default=sharing_defaults.get(owner_id),
349	        ).visible:
350	            continue
351	        hits.append(message_hit(row, timezone=_ctx_timezone(ctx), now=_ctx_now(ctx)))
352	    return SearchMessagesOutput(hits=hits, truncated=len(rows) == args.limit)
353

355	async def list_bridge_candidates(ctx: TurnContext, args: ListBridgeCandidatesInput) -> ListBridgeCandidatesOutput:
356	    logger.info("read tool list_bridge_candidates turn_id=%s", ctx.turn_id)
357	    _err = check_read_scope(ctx, args.scope)
358	    if _err is not None:
359	        return ListBridgeCandidatesOutput(is_error=True, error=_err, candidates=[], truncated=False)
360	    rows = await ctx.pool.fetch(
361	        """
362	        SELECT id, source_user_id, target_user_id, kind, status, sensitivity, partner_path,
363	               COALESCE(source_message_ids, '{}'::uuid[]) AS source_message_ids,
364	               COALESCE(related_memory_ids, '{}'::uuid[]) AS related_memory_ids,
365	               COALESCE(related_observation_ids, '{}'::uuid[]) AS related_observation_ids,
366	               internal_note, shareable_summary, sent_message_id,
367	               created_at, updated_at, resolved_at
368	        FROM bridge_candidates
369	        WHERE (
370	            (source_user_id=$1 AND target_user_id=$2)
371	            OR (source_user_id=$2 AND target_user_id=$1)
372	        )
373	          AND ($3::uuid IS NULL OR source_user_id=$3)
374	          AND ($4::uuid IS NULL OR target_user_id=$4)
375	          AND ($5::text IS NULL OR status=$5)
376	          AND ($6::text IS NULL OR partner_path=$6)
377	        ORDER BY created_at DESC
378	        LIMIT $7
379	        """,
380	        ctx.user.id,
381	        ctx.partner.id,
382	        args.source_user_id,
383	        args.target_user_id,
384	        args.status.value if args.status is not None else None,
385	        args.partner_path.value if args.partner_path is not None else None,
386	        args.limit,
387	    )
388	    candidates: list[BridgeCandidate] = []
389	    for row in rows:
390	        if row["target_user_id"] == ctx.user.id and row["source_user_id"] != ctx.user.id:
391	            if not bridge_candidate_visible_to_target(row, target_user_id=ctx.user.id):
392	                continue
393	            row = {**dict(row), "internal_note": None}
394	        candidates.append(_bridge_candidate(row))
395	    return ListBridgeCandidatesOutput(candidates=candidates, truncated=len(rows) == args.limit)
396	
397	
398	def _bridge_candidate(row: Any) -> BridgeCandidate:
399	    data = dict(row)
400	    data.setdefault("partner_path", "message_partner")
401	    data["source_message_ids"] = list(data.get("source_message_ids") or [])
402	    data["related_memory_ids"] = list(data.get("related_memory_ids") or [])
403	    data["related_observation_ids"] = list(data.get("related_observation_ids") or [])
404	    return BridgeCandidate.model_validate(data)

407	async def search_emojis(ctx: TurnContext, args: SearchEmojisInput) -> SearchEmojisOutput:
408	    logger.info("read tool search_emojis turn_id=%s", ctx.turn_id)
409	    query_terms = _emoji_terms(args.query)
410	    candidates: list[EmojiSearchHit] = []
411	    used_full_dataset = False
412	
413	    try:
414	        import emoji as emoji_pkg  # type: ignore
415	
416	        used_full_dataset = True
417	        for symbol, data in emoji_pkg.EMOJI_DATA.items():
418	            raw_name = str(data.get("en") or "").strip(":").replace("_", " ")
419	            aliases = [str(item).strip(":").replace("_", " ") for item in data.get("alias", []) or []]
420	            keywords = [str(item).replace("_", " ") for item in data.get("variant", []) or []]
421	            if symbol in _EMOJI_FALLBACK:
422	                fallback_name, fallback_keywords = _EMOJI_FALLBACK[symbol]
423	                aliases.append(fallback_name)
424	                keywords.extend(fallback_keywords)
425	            score = _emoji_score(query_terms, raw_name, aliases, keywords)
426	            if score > 0:
427	                candidates.append(
428	                    EmojiSearchHit(
429	                        emoji=symbol,
430	                        name=raw_name,
431	                        aliases=aliases,
432	                        keywords=keywords,
433	                        score=score,
434	                    )
435	                )
436	    except Exception:
437	        for symbol, (name, keywords) in _EMOJI_FALLBACK.items():
438	            score = _emoji_score(query_terms, name, [], keywords)
439	            if score > 0:
440	                candidates.append(
441	                    EmojiSearchHit(
442	                        emoji=symbol,
443	                        name=name,
444	                        keywords=keywords,
445	                        score=score,
446	                    )
447	                )
448	
449	    candidates.sort(key=lambda hit: (-hit.score, len(hit.name), hit.name, hit.emoji))
450	    return SearchEmojisOutput(query=args.query, hits=candidates[: args.limit], used_full_dataset=used_full_dataset)
451

453	async def recent_activity(ctx: TurnContext, args: RecentActivityInput) -> RecentActivityOutput:
454	    logger.info("read tool recent_activity turn_id=%s", ctx.turn_id)
455	    end = _ctx_now(ctx)
456	    start = end - timedelta(days=args.days)
457	    rows = await ctx.pool.fetch(
458	        """
459	        SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.name AS user_name, u.cross_thread_sharing_default, COUNT(m.id) AS message_count,
460	               MAX(m.sent_at) AS last_message_at,
461	               (ARRAY_AGG(m.content ORDER BY m.sent_at DESC))[1] AS latest_content
462	        FROM users u
463	        LEFT JOIN messages m
464	          ON (m.sender_id = u.id OR m.recipient_id = u.id)
465	         AND m.sent_at >= $1
466	         AND m.sent_at <= $2
467	         AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
468	        WHERE u.id = ANY($3::uuid[])
469	        GROUP BY u.id, u.name, u.cross_thread_sharing_default
470	        ORDER BY last_message_at DESC NULLS LAST, u.name ASC
471	        """,
472	        start,
473	        end,
474	        [ctx.user.id, ctx.partner.id],
475	    )
476	    threads: list[ThreadDigest] = []
477	    for row in rows:
478	        count = int(value(row, "message_count", 0))
479	        sharing_default = value(row, "cross_thread_sharing_default", None)
480	        if row["user_id"] == ctx.user.id:
481	            sharing_default = ctx.user.cross_thread_sharing_default
482	        elif row["user_id"] == ctx.partner.id:
483	            sharing_default = ctx.partner.cross_thread_sharing_default
484	        can_show_latest = raw_message_visibility(
485	            viewer_user_id=ctx.user.id,
486	            thread_owner_user_id=row["user_id"],
487	            thread_owner_sharing_default=sharing_default,
488	        ).visible
489	        snippet = (value(row, "latest_content", "") or "")[:160] if can_show_latest else ""
490	        # Plan 3 stub. tool_schemas.ThreadDigest.summary describes an LLM-generated digest; deferring the Haiku digest to Plan 4 alongside the significance scorer.
491	        if can_show_latest:
492	            summary = f'{count} messages this period; latest: "{snippet}"'
493	        else:
494	            summary = f"{count} messages this period; latest content hidden by sharing_default"
495	        threads.append(
496	            ThreadDigest(
497	                user_id=row["user_id"],
498	                user_name=row["user_name"],
499	                message_count=count,
500	                last_message_at=row["last_message_at"],
501	                last_message_at_time=_time(row["last_message_at"], ctx),
502	                summary=summary,
503	            )
504	        )
505	    return RecentActivityOutput(
506	        threads=threads,
507	        period=DateRange(start=start, end=end),
508	        period_time={"start": _time(start, ctx), "end": _time(end, ctx)},
509	    )
510	
511	
512	def _message_thread_owner_id(row: Any) -> Any:
513	    if row["direction"] == "inbound" and row["sender_id"] is not None:
514	        return row["sender_id"]
515	    if row["direction"] == "outbound" and row["recipient_id"] is not None:
516	        return row["recipient_id"]
517	    return row["sender_id"] or row["recipient_id"]

679	async def get_distillations(ctx: TurnContext, args: GetDistillationsInput) -> GetDistillationsOutput:
680	    _err = check_read_scope(ctx, args.scope)
681	    if _err is not None:
682	        return GetDistillationsOutput(is_error=True, error=_err, distillations=[])
683	    logger.info("read tool get_distillations turn_id=%s", ctx.turn_id)
684	    clauses = ["d.status = $1"]
685	    params: list[Any] = [args.status.value]
686	    if args.source_user_id is not None:
687	        params.append(args.source_user_id)
688	        clauses.append(f"${len(params)} = ANY(COALESCE(d.source_user_ids, '{{}}'::uuid[]))")
689	    if args.related_theme_id is not None:
690	        params.append(args.related_theme_id)
691	        clauses.append(f"${len(params)} = ANY(COALESCE(d.related_theme_ids, '{{}}'::uuid[]))")
692	    if args.related_memory_id is not None:
693	        params.append(args.related_memory_id)
694	        clauses.append(f"${len(params)} = ANY(COALESCE(d.related_memory_ids, '{{}}'::uuid[]))")
695	    if args.related_observation_id is not None:
696	        params.append(args.related_observation_id)
697	        clauses.append(f"${len(params)} = ANY(COALESCE(d.related_observation_ids, '{{}}'::uuid[]))")
698	    if args.supporting_message_id is not None:
699	        params.append(args.supporting_message_id)
700	        clauses.append(f"${len(params)} = ANY(COALESCE(d.supporting_message_ids, '{{}}'::uuid[]))")
701	    if args.text_contains:
702	        params.append(f"%{args.text_contains}%")
703	        clauses.append(
704	            f"""(
705	                d.content ILIKE ${len(params)}
706	                OR d.shareable_summary ILIKE ${len(params)}
707	                OR d.revision_note ILIKE ${len(params)}
708	            )"""
709	        )
710	    params.append(args.limit)
711	    rows = await ctx.pool.fetch(
712	        f"""
713	        SELECT d.id, d.content, d.confidence, d.status, d.sensitivity, d.visibility, d.shareable_summary,
714	               COALESCE(d.source_user_ids, '{{}}'::uuid[]) AS source_user_ids,
715	               COALESCE(d.related_memory_ids, '{{}}'::uuid[]) AS related_memory_ids,
716	               COALESCE(d.related_observation_ids, '{{}}'::uuid[]) AS related_observation_ids,
717	               COALESCE(d.related_theme_ids, '{{}}'::uuid[]) AS related_theme_ids,
718	               COALESCE(d.supporting_message_ids, '{{}}'::uuid[]) AS supporting_message_ids,
719	               d.created_from_tool_call_id, d.triggering_message_id,
720	               d.supersedes_distillation_id, d.superseded_by_distillation_id,
721	               d.revision_note, d.revision_count,
722	               d.created_at, d.updated_at, d.revised_at, d.retired_at
723	        FROM distillations d
724	        {join_artifact_topics('d', f'${len(params) + 1}')}
725	        WHERE {' AND '.join(clauses)}
726	        ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC, d.created_at DESC
727	        LIMIT ${len(params)}
728	        """,
729	        *params, ctx.primary_topic_id,
730	    )
731	    sharing_defaults = {
732	        ctx.user.id: normalize_sharing_default(ctx.user.cross_thread_sharing_default),
733	        ctx.partner.id: normalize_sharing_default(ctx.partner.cross_thread_sharing_default),
734	    }
735	    visible_rows = []
736	    for row in rows:
737	        source_user_ids = list(row["source_user_ids"] or [])
738	        full_visible = bool(source_user_ids) and all(
739	            raw_message_visibility(
740	                viewer_user_id=ctx.user.id,
741	                thread_owner_user_id=source_user_id,
742	                thread_owner_sharing_default=sharing_defaults.get(source_user_id),
743	            ).visible
744	            for source_user_id in source_user_ids
745	        )
746	        if full_visible:
747	            visible_rows.append(row)
748	            continue
749	        if row["visibility"] == "dyad_shareable" and row["shareable_summary"]:
750	            safe_row = dict(row)
751	            safe_row["content"] = row["shareable_summary"]
752	            safe_row["revision_note"] = None
753	            visible_rows.append(safe_row)
754	    return GetDistillationsOutput(
755	        distillations=[distillation_row(row, timezone=_ctx_timezone(ctx), now=_ctx_now(ctx)) for row in visible_rows]
756	    )

476	        result = {

483	        result = {

510	        await _log_tool_call(ctx, "send_bridge_candidate", args, started, result)
511	        return result
512	
513	    sent_message_id = await send_outbound(
514	        ctx.pool,
515	        target,
516	        content,
517	        bot_turn_id=ctx.turn_id,
518	        protected_owner_ids=protected_owner_ids,
519	        bot_id=ctx.bot_id,
520	        topic_id=ctx.primary_topic_id,
521	    )
522	    row = await _set_bridge_candidate_status(
523	        ctx,
524	        args.candidate_id,

526	        sent_message_id=sent_message_id,
527	    )
528	    await _append_turn_reasoning(
529	        ctx.pool,
530	        ctx.turn_id,
531	        f"Bridge candidate sent candidate_id={args.candidate_id} sent_message_id={sent_message_id}. reason={args.reason or ''}",
532	    )
533	    result = SendBridgeCandidateOutput(candidate=_bridge_candidate(row))
534	    await _log_tool_call(ctx, "send_bridge_candidate", args, started, result)
535	    return result

538	def _bridge_users_in_current_dyad(ctx: TurnContext, source_user_id: Any, target_user_id: Any) -> bool:

1222	async def update_distillation(ctx: TurnContext, args: UpdateDistillationInput) -> UpdateDistillationOutput:
1223	    _err = check_write_scope(ctx)
1224	    if _err is not None:
1225	        raise ToolCallRejected({"error": _err})
1226	    started = _start()
1227	    try:
1228	        await _require_existing_distillation_links(
1229	            ctx,
1230	            source_user_ids=args.source_user_ids,
1231	            related_memory_ids=args.related_memory_ids,
1232	            related_observation_ids=args.related_observation_ids,
1233	            related_theme_ids=args.related_theme_ids,
1234	            supporting_message_ids=args.supporting_message_ids,
1235	        )
1236	    except ToolCallRejected as exc:
1237	        await _log_tool_call(ctx, "update_distillation", args, started, exc.result)
1238	        raise
1239	    sets = ["updated_at=now()"]
1240	    params: list[Any] = []
1241	    for field in (
1242	        "content",
1243	        "confidence",
1244	        "status",
1245	        "sensitivity",
1246	        "visibility",
1247	        "shareable_summary",
1248	        "source_user_ids",
1249	        "related_memory_ids",
1250	        "related_observation_ids",
1251	        "related_theme_ids",
1252	        "supporting_message_ids",
1253	        "revision_note",
1254	    ):
1255	        field_value = getattr(args, field)
1256	        if field_value is None:
1257	            continue
1258	        value = field_value.value if hasattr(field_value, "value") else field_value
1259	        params.append(value)
1260	        cast = "::uuid[]" if field.endswith("_ids") else ""
1261	        sets.append(f"{field}=${len(params)}{cast}")
1262	        if field == "content":
1263	            params.append(encrypt_value(value))
1264	            sets.append(f"content_encrypted=${len(params)}")
1265	        elif field == "shareable_summary":
1266	            params.append(encrypt_value(value))
1267	            sets.append(f"shareable_summary_encrypted=${len(params)}")
1268	    if args.status is not None and args.status.value == "retired":
1269	        sets.append("retired_at=COALESCE(retired_at, now())")
1270	    params.append(args.distillation_id)
1271	    row = await ctx.pool.fetchrow(
1272	        f"UPDATE distillations SET {', '.join(sets)} WHERE id=${len(params)} RETURNING id",
1273	        *params,
1274	    )
1275	    result = UpdateDistillationOutput(id=row["id"])
1276	    await _log_tool_call(ctx, "update_distillation", args, started, result)
1277	    return result
